instruction: What is the title of the most played song by Velvet Echo on Spotify.
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so all actions are lookups. Spotify search_artists/search_songs are public APIs needing no access token, hence no spotify-login action; supervisor.show_profile and supervisor.show_account_passwords are modeled (as in the reference solution) but are not required by any precondition, so a planner's minimal plan may omit them (search_artists -> search_songs -> complete_task). The artist object doubles as its artist_id once (known-id) holds after search_artists; the sort key object encodes sort_by="-play_count" so the first search_songs result is the most played song. supervisor-complete-task takes the song as the answer parameter (its title) and the artist as a non-API task record, with precondition equal to the task-specific goal (found-most-played ...) plus (not (task-completed)); it is the only action asserting (task-completed), and every other action requires (not (task-completed)), forcing it to be last.
